title: Swarm Intelligence Coordinator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Assigns distributed tasks to robot groups using local observations and shared objectives. A proposed coordinator for robot swarms: it assigns distributed tasks to groups of robots that decide locally from their own observations while pursuing shared objectives. The coordinator sets the objectives and constraints; the swarm works out the details — with the coordinator able to audit and override.
capabilities: Assign tasks to robot groups by capability and position
Let robots decide locally from their observations
Keep the swarm aligned to shared objectives
Audit swarm decisions with full trails
Override or recall the swarm when needed
